title: Cognitive therapy of anxiety disorders a practice manual and conceptual guide
abstract: Cognitive Theory and Models of Anxiety: An Introduction. Assessment: An Overview. Cognitive Therapy: Basic Characteristics. Cognitive Therapy: Basic Techniques. Panic Disorder. Hypochondriasis: Health Anxiety. Social Phobia. Generalised Anxiety Disorder. Obsessive-Compulsive Disorder. Future Developments in Cognitive Therapy. Rating Scales. Appendix. References. Index.

claims.text: Cognitive therapy provides structured models and techniques for assessing and treating specific anxiety disorders.

methodologies.name: Cognitive Therapy for Anxiety Disorders
methodologies.description: A psychological intervention approach using cognitive models, systematic assessment, and target-specific techniques to treat various anxiety conditions.
